lines.text: Good morning. Tell me about the stiffness.
Since last time the morning stiffness lasts about two hours before I can bend down to my socks.
And since last time I get evening pain in the low back after tea most nights.
Morning stiffness that long, easing as you get moving, plus pain in the evenings, I'd like your GP to check your bloods for an inflammatory cause.
Afternoons are my best time, I'm fine by then.
I'll write to the GP today. In the meantime, do the spinal stretches as soon as you get up, before your shower, and put a hot water bottle on the low back in the evening.
If the pain starts waking you every night or you're losing weight without trying, ring me before your next appointment.
